hlg_7691cb13451b89d6_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable citizens of Turin to submit, track, and interact with geolocated civic reports while managing anonymity, receiving real-time updates, and engaging with municipal operators through a secure, interactive platform with optional personal identification features.
hlg_7691cb13451b89d6_001.rationale: llg_001 enables user onboarding and account activation for report eligibility; llg_002 allows geolocation via map selection; llg_003 defines core report submission with mandatory fields and media; llg_004 introduces anonymous submission capability; llg_005 provides real-time status notifications; llg_006 enables private messaging with operators; llg_007 allows public visualization of reports on an interactive map; llg_008 provides filtered, sortable report summaries; llg_009 enables report following and cross-report notifications; llg_010 adds optional personal photo for notifications and summaries. Together, these form a complete civic reporting system with user management, geospatial interaction, communication, and visibility features — including the outlier llg_010 which introduces optional personal branding, not directly tied to core reporting but included as a distinct capability.

hlg_b9167a622cc75e91_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Citizen interacts with a public interactive map to view and filter reports by category, status, or location, and sort them according to specified criteria.
hlg_b9167a622cc75e91_001.rationale: llg_001 enables the citizen to view a public interactive map displaying all reports with filters and location context; llg_002 adds the capability to apply filters and sorting by category or status, which extends the interaction beyond mere viewing to active refinement of the displayed data.

hlg_dcd27efd828c1694_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Citizen receives real-time and email-based notifications about report status changes and direct messages from municipal staff, with configurable notification preferences including disabling email notifications and accessing notifications via external chatbots.
hlg_dcd27efd828c1694_001.rationale: llg_001 enables citizens to view report status and updates; llg_002 provides real-time notifications for state changes; llg_003 allows direct messaging with municipal staff; llg_004 delivers email notifications for updates or messages; llg_005 lets citizens disable email notifications via settings; llg_006 extends notification access to external chatbots. Together, these define a multi-channel, configurable notification and messaging system for citizens interacting with municipal report processes.

hlg_ccc7734d1de6e0ef_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Provide public, anonymous access to aggregated report statistics and an interactive map of report locations without requiring user authentication.
hlg_ccc7734d1de6e0ef_001.rationale: llg_001 enables non-registered users to view public statistics on report trends and categories, which implies data aggregation and visualization for public consumption. llg_002 enables non-registered users to view a public interactive map of reports, which implies spatial visualization and location-based data presentation. Together, these LLGs define a scope of public-facing, anonymous data visualization tools focused on report trends and geographic distribution — no authentication is required for either capability.

View public interactive map without login

hlg_fc8aaf6fc932edfc_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable citizen report review and decision-making with mandatory justification for rejection by organization office staff.
hlg_fc8aaf6fc932edfc_001.rationale: llg_001 introduces the capability for organization office staff to review citizen reports and make binary decisions (approve or reject) with mandatory explanation required for rejection. No other LLGs are provided, so the reconstructed goal must fully encompass this single, distinct functional capability without adding or omitting anything.
source_low_level_goal_ids: Review citizen report for approval or rejection

hlg_ff4642dfb9b0a7fb_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Assign reports to appropriate departments or external companies based on report category, with technical office staff as the assigning actor.
hlg_ff4642dfb9b0a7fb_001.rationale: llg_001 specifies that technical office staff assign reports to departments or external companies based on category — this is the only LLG provided, and it introduces the actor (technical office staff), the object (reports), the decision criterion (category), and the action (assign). No other LLGs are supplied, so no additional capabilities can be inferred or included.
source_low_level_goal_ids: Assign report to appropriate department or external company

hlg_ff99f6f5d954d8db_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Municipal Administrator to view both public report statistics and private system performance analytics for comprehensive oversight of report trends and infrastructure health.
hlg_ff99f6f5d954d8db_001.rationale: llg_001 enables the Municipal Administrator to view public report statistics and trends, which supports transparency and trend analysis for public-facing data. llg_002 enables access to private system performance analytics, which supports internal monitoring of system health and resource allocation. Together, these capabilities form a dual-view oversight system: one for public data trends and one for private system metrics — no other capability is inferred or omitted, and the reconstructed goal explicitly preserves both distinct domains of access.
source_low_level_goal_ids: View public report statistics and trends
View private system performance analytics

hlg_bf787da4fb4e0b50_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Prepare and publish a municipal system as open-source software on https://developers.italia.it/, including configuring system settings for release and executing the public publication.
hlg_bf787da4fb4e0b50_001.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to configure system settings specifically for an open-source release and integration with https://developers.italia.it/. llg_002 adds the capability to publish the system as open-source on that platform. Together, they form a complete scope covering both configuration and publication, with no hidden or inferred functionality.
